commit.message: feat: Add ProviderInstaller interface to the views package
refactor: Make provider-installation methods use new `ProviderInstaller` interface, so view implementations from different commands can be used with that logic.

fix: Remove duplicate rendering of 'Provider installation was canceled' error diagnostic

The returned diags variable will be rendered by the calling code, too.

PSS: Avoid errors from nil locks, due to using providers not managed by Terraform, when detecting config changes during init  (#38743)

This changes logic that determines if a state migration scenario is happening, or what type of scenario it is, so that it no longer panics when attempting to compare version data when the provider is not managed by Terraform. Version data is only present and/or relevant if the provider is managed by Terraform, so that comparison now only happens when that is the case.

Also, added a test showing it's possible to run multiple init commands when no changes are present while using a dev_override provider. Refactored other tests.

commit.message:
refactor: Change parsing of `state_store_provider` blocks in .tfmigrate.hcl files to use `StateStoreProviderRequirement` structs (#38780)

Previously we reused RequiredProvider structs, but these contained fields we didn't use and also the version constraint data wasn't in a 'shape' that matched what provider download logic requires. Given that the state_store_provider block is intended to be used during a provider installation step we now make the block be parsed into the required type immediately, instead of re-shaping the data later on in the `state migrate` command implementation.

Note: We use parsing into a version.Version as a shortcut to disallow strings that aren't for a specific version, i.e. only "1.0.0" format is allowed.

commit.message:
cloud: show a summary of Terraform policy results for plan and apply

When a plan or apply runs against HCP Terraform with the Terraform policy
feature, print a short summary of the policy results in the CLI: an overall
pass/fail, and per stage a breakdown (passed/failed/unknown) with each policy
set and policy.

Outcomes are read from HCP Terraform via the run-level tfpolicy API, so this
bumps go-tfe to v1.108.0. Plan shows the init and plan stages, apply shows the
apply stage, and destroy reuses the apply path. If the backend doesn't return
outcomes, it falls back to the previous message.
cloud: address review feedback on Terraform policy summary
cloud: update policy paths plan test for removed success message

PSS: Test coverage for `init` detecting changes in how a state store is configured. (#38772)

Added tests showing that init detects changes in how PSS is used and raises errors referring users to the new `state migrate` command. This includes detection of provider version changes, which can only happen if changes happen out of band but we still need to protect against it.
